name: CacheCraft (Java 21)
postCreateCommand: chmod +x mvnw && ./mvnw -q -DskipTests dependency:go-offline && sudo gpg -k || true && sudo gpg --no-default-keyring --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/k6-archive-keyring.gpg --keyserver hkp://keyserver.ubuntu.com:80 --recv-keys C5AD17C747E3415A3642D57D77C6C491D6AC1D69 && echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/k6-archive-keyring.gpg] https://dl.k6.io/deb stable main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/k6.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y k6
